messages:
tess: Heads up — travel nightmare. Flight cancelled in SFO, I can't cover the 00:00-06:00 UTC EU-midnight window tonight. Sorry for the late ask, need someone to take primary.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager flood detected — 4x 5xx from /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1) in last 6m. Alerting primary.

jamie: I can take primary for 00:00-02:00 UTC (cover first half). I'll be online and can respond to pages.

alex: I can pick up 02:00-06:00 UTC if needed — confirm I'll be primary after jamie. Have VPN + HSM access.

mike: Quick check from the dashboards — embed queue latency spiked but errors dropped after a warm restart earlier. Not sure if still flaky; keep an eye on 5xx rate.

sara: I can shadow as secondary for the whole window. I'll keep the SLO dashboard open and monitor traces.

jamie: Ack. I'll also keep a bridge ready if error rate > 3%. If anyone sees customer-impact (major customers degraded) ping #support and I'll open the bridge immediately.

mike: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-5xx.md — follow step 2 (drain worker), step 4 (restart worker with new env), and step 7 (rollback quantization flags if flapping).

jamie: Doing the handover steps now. Leaving a short runbook snippet here so primary knows quick commands:
```
# drain node then restart embed workers
kubectl -n inference cordon node/<name>
kubectl -n inference drain node/<name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embed-worker
```

oncall-bot: Reminder — update PagerDuty schedule if swapping manually: `pd-schedule swap tess jamie 2026-03-15T00:00Z 2026-03-15T02:00Z` and `pd-schedule swap tess alex 2026-03-15T02:00Z 2026-03-15T06:00Z`. Or use the Console -> Oncall -> Swap.

tess: Thank you jamie/alex/sara. I've DM'd jamie the prod keys and the small list of VIP customers to watch. Really appreciate the quick cover.

alex: Confirmed I'll take over at 02:00 UTC. I'll run a quick health-check script on the embed pool at 01:55 and post results in this thread.

jamie: Posted initial check at 00:10 — error rate down to 0.8%, tail latency 120ms p95. Keeping the bridge closed for now. Will escalate if >2% 5xx for 5m.

sara: I'll run sampling on recent traces and watch for tokenization errors; if you see malformed requests include the raw body in the ticket.

mike: FYI: if the issue recurs and restarting doesn't hold, consider switching to the backup model variant `embed-v2-small` using the routing policy in Console (Route -> Fallback -> embed-v2-small). That will reduce quality slightly but preserves latency.

jamie: Acknowledged. Will keep fallback as plan B.

tess: Thanks again — I owe you all coffee. Passing primary to jamie at 00:00 UTC.

oncall-bot: Update: Pager suppressed (auto-silenced) for thread 4478901234 by jamie.

alex: Taking over in 10 minutes. All notes received.

jamie: Handed over to alex at 02:00 UTC — alex is primary, sara shadow, I remain available for consult.

alex: Running the 01:55 health-check now — embed-worker pods: 5/5 ready, 0 restarts in last hour, errors 0.6% over 5m. No immediate action.

jamie: Closing my watch. If anyone needs me I’ll be reachable via DM. Good handoff. :thumbsup:

mike: Postmortem checklist: if this resurfaces during the weekend, capture throttling metrics and the exact model variants served, then tag the eval team.

alex: Will keep thread updated and escalate if anything changes.

oncall-bot: Thread 4478901234 marked as active until 2026-03-15T06:00Z.

sara: Noted. Monitoring continues.
